**How do I save my project and come back later**
1. Click "Save / Open" in the top toolbar (SPB Projects). It saves the project zones and layer state plus the source-paint path in one project file. Keep that source available at the saved path to reopen it.
2. To reopen, click "Save / Open" again and load it.
Exact controls: Save / Open (Pro > top toolbar (tool row)); SAVE SHOKK (Pro > left column > ZONES > More (three-dot) menu).

Clearcoat is the B channel of the spec map. It controls the clear reflective coating: lower channel values give stronger gloss (16 is maximum gloss; 0–15 means no clearcoat), while higher values are duller. It changes material response, not the paint color.

**How do I undo**
1. Press Ctrl+Z, or the Undo button in the top toolbar (HISTORY menu).
2. To go back several steps open "Undo History...".
3. Under an AI panel answer press Undo to take back that whole answer. In Easy use UNDO at the top.
Exact controls: Undo Ctrl+Z (Pro > top toolbar (tool row)); Undo History… (Pro > top toolbar (tool row)); Undo (Shokker AI panel).
